results.requirement_text: Torrent search will share the same search bar with the streaming search.
results.text_predicate:
Requirement REQ-1 (System Features > Torrent Search > Functional Requirements):
Torrent search will share the same search bar with the streaming search.
results.lean_predicate:
structure Input where
  query          : String
  streaming      : Bool
  torrent        : Bool
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

structure Output where
  results       : List String
  message       : String
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def Spec : Contract Input Output where
  pre  := fun i => i.query ≠ ""
  post := fun i o =>
    (o.message = "No results were found." ↔ o.results = []) ∧
    (∀ r ∈ o.results, r = i.query) ∧
    (i.streaming ∨ i.torrent) →
    (o.results.length ≤ 100) ∧
    (o.results.length > 0 ↔ o.message = "") ∧
    (o.results.length = 0 ↔ o.message = "No results were found.") ∧
    (o.results.length > 0 → o.message = "") ∧
    (i.streaming ∨ i.torrent) ↔
    (o.results.length = 0 ∧ o.message = "Torrent search requires streaming search to be enabled.")

example : Spec.pre { query := "cats", streaming := true, torrent := false } ∧ Spec.post { query := "cats", streaming := true, torrent := false } { results := ["cats"], message := "a" } := by
  unfold Spec; decide
results.bad_example:
example : Spec.pre { query := "test", streaming := false, torrent := true } ∧ ¬ Spec.post { query := "test", streaming := false, torrent := true } { results := [], message := "No results were found." } := by
  unfold Spec; decide

negative_examples.example:
example : Spec.pre { query := "test", streaming := false, torrent := true } ∧ ¬ Spec.post { query := "test", streaming := false, torrent := true } { results := [], message := "No results were found." } := by
  unfold Spec; decide
negative_examples.why: The requirement states that torrent search will share the same search bar with the streaming search, meaning torrent search cannot be enabled without streaming search.

structure Item where
  name   : String
  source : String
  rating : Nat
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

structure Input where
  query          : String
  items          : List Item
  includeArchive : Bool
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

structure Output where
  results : List Item
  message : String
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

-- an item may be returned: it matches the query, its source is switched on,
-- and its rating is not less than 1
def Wanted (i : Input) (it : Item) : Bool :=
  it.name == i.query && (i.includeArchive || it.source != "archive") && 1 ≤ it.rating

def Spec : Contract Input Output where
  pre  := fun i => i.query ≠ ""
  post := fun i o =>
    (∀ it ∈ o.results, it ∈ i.items ∧ Wanted i it = true) ∧
    (o.message = "No results were found." ↔ o.results = [])
